title: C-04 BAPLIE parse payload (queue:edi)
description: Payload of a BAPLIE_PARSE job (CT-12). The EDI Parser accepts SMDG BAPLIE 2.2.1 (UN/EDIFACT D.95B) and SMDG BAPLIE 3.1.1 (UN/EDIFACT D.13B), detected from the UNH message identifier. Any other version, message type or non-EDIFACT file ends as outcome REJECTED (parse_status FAILED) with an ERROR issue on segment UNH.

source.description: FILE parses the uploaded file. STAGED_PAYLOAD re-validates and commits the staff-corrected staged_payload of a QUARANTINED file.
